name: prologscript
description: PrologScript: Prolog in place of JavaScript, its commands made visual (menus, painting, vector graphics, drag and drop, pointers): a plug-in for Visual Starlog in LucianOS, and a pack that works on its own

scripts.proofs: swipl -g main -t halt proofs/theorems.pl && swipl -g check -t halt proofs/ios.pl
